answer: Self‑attention layers need only a constant number of sequential operations (O(1)) and have a constant maximum path length between any two positions (O(1))[Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, PDF p. 6]. Recurrent layers require O(n) sequential operations and their maximum path length also grows linearly with the sequence length (O(n))[Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, PDF p. 6].
